info.name: Will Hunting - Genio ribelle
info.plot: Will Hunting è un ragazzo orfano dedito a piccoli furti, ma con grandi capacità per la matematica. Queste doti vengono notate da un professore universitario, che mandandolo da un suo amico psichiatra cerca di aiutarlo a togliersi dalla strada.

translations.overview: Will Hunting is a headstrong, working-class genius who is failing the lessons of life. After one too many run-ins with the law, Will's last chance is a psychology professor, who might be the only man who can reach him.
translations.tagline: Some people can never believe in themselves, until someone believes in them.
